messages:
Tara M: Noticed an uptick in user reports -> partial messages then silent TCP close on /v1/streaming-chat around 23:14 UTC. Starting follow-up thread to track owners and remediation.
Lin (SRE): Thanks. Any sample traces or headers?
Tara M: Pushing a trimmed trace: 
```
[23:14:03] conn_id=zz12 stream_event=token_chunk size=768
[23:14:03] conn_id=zz12 stream_event=HALF_CHUNK
[23:14:03] conn_id=zz12 tcp_state=FIN_SENT error=EOF
```
Diego - Runtime: Matches what our client SDK telemetry sent: saw abrupt socket close after partial payload. Could be idle timeouts in envoy or ALB or an upstream restart.
Priya K: I'll correlate with LB metrics. If envoy upstream_conns_closed_by_downstream spikes that's telling.
Oleg: Suggest capture plan: add ephemeral tcpdump on ingress nodes for 4h during peak and filter for RST/FIN around streaming endpoints. I'll own pcap collection.
DeployBot: Change request ticket created: INFRA-1291 for ALB timeout change.
Lin (SRE): Ownership proposal: Priya - LB/Envoy metrics and rollback play, Oleg - packet capture & pcap analysis, Diego - runtime logs + SDK resume behavior, Tara - customer comms and incident doc, Maya - Priority validation + exec updates.
Tara M: Proposed immediate mitigations: set ALB idle timeout to 180s, enable SO_KEEPALIVE on runtime sockets, add application-level heartbeat frame every 12s. Thoughts?
Diego - Runtime: Heartbeat frame is low-risk. Will prepare small patch to emit \u2018hb\u2019 frames. SDK will ignore these frames in the stream parser.
Priya K: ALB change low risk but will schedule in maintenance window in 2h. Have rollback plan to previous config.
Oleg: tcpdump wrapper PR ready; will run on canary first and then prod. Will upload pcaps to /incidents/2134609999/pcaps.
Lin (SRE): Detection: add a streaming_integrity metric: partial_chunks / total_chunks; alert if >0.2% for 10m. Also add correlation alert for envoy upstream reset rate.
Diego - Runtime: For SDK, add resume-on-409 and resume-token logic. Also add a client-side watchdog that attempts one reconnect quickly (200-500ms) and then backoff.
Tara M: Timeline I propose: detection + alert rules by 12h, heartbeat + SDK patch in 36h, ALB + keepalive change in 24h, tcpdump and analysis within 48h, customer note + PM update in 72h.
Priya K: I'll verify canary after ALB change and post results in this thread.
Maya S: FYI tagging: added label recurrence:stream-silent-close and linked to incident 1915000000 (similar proxy idle bug in Feb). Good to track regression.
Oleg: After capture I'll run wireshark filter: tcp.analysis.retransmission || tcp.flags.reset || tcp.flags.fin and share timestamps.
Lin (SRE): Also add a synthetic test that intentionally drops connection mid-stream to validate resume logic and to measure user-visible time-to-resume. Diego, can you add to ci/synthetics?
Diego - Runtime: Yes, will add a synthetic that emits partial payload then sends RST; will assert SDK resumes and final payload integrity.
Tara M: Action recap: 1) Priya - ALB + envoy metric checks + canary verification (INFRA-1291); 2) Oleg - pcap capture + analysis; 3) Diego - runtime heartbeat + SDK resume patch + synthetics; 4) Lin - detection rules + alerting; 5) Maya - customer comms + incident doc.
DeployBot: Reminder: Please add risk and rollback notes to INFRA-1291 before applying changes.
Priya K: Will post canary metrics in 2.5h.
Oleg: Schedule capture run starting 22:00 UTC for 6h, will upload pcaps to incident folder when done.
Diego - Runtime: SDK patch PR opened: https://git.internal/runtime/pulls/542, adding resume unit tests.
Lin (SRE): I'll draft the Grafana panel for streaming_integrity and set a warning threshold at 0.1% and critical at 0.5%.
Maya S: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the customer status update after we confirm ALB behavior on canary. Quick sync tomorrow 09:30 to validate blockers. Ping here if anything urgent. :white_check_mark:
